scope: Frozen cumulative reports, summary ledgers and available run records for runtime/A/A1/checkpoint families, plus known historical token reductions. Includes higher arm totals for context. Not an exhaustive mining of every raw provider response.
not_token_treatment_evidence: lossless storage/serialization byte savings without measured provider usage
claim_gate: No lower total here is a causal/claim-ready token saving for PRODUCT_HYGIENE_RC. Representation experiments make historical mechanisms plausible but do not transfer to the retained invisible product.
usage_accounting_caveat: Archived summary rows can contain zero usage for failed/censored requests. Source-provided zeros are preserved, not interpreted as observed zero work. Missing usage fields are never newly imputed; lower totals do not establish comparable completed work.
mechanism_flag_definition: Flags distinguish changes to visible evidence/interface from deterministic backend changes. Neither flag implies causal attribution to this RC.
